excluded.platformServersList: Hosted directory of community servers curated by screeps.com; a standalone server is an entry in that directory, not a provider of it.
excluded.platformExperimentalPvp: Experimental screeps.com multi-shard combat analytics; not used by the official client and not part of the private-server protocol (backend-local has no such route).
excluded.platformExperimentalNukes: Experimental screeps.com multi-shard nuke analytics; not used by the official client and not part of the private-server protocol (backend-local has no such route).
excluded.platformOfficialRoomHistory: Static history host of screeps.com (`HISTORY_URL/<shard>/<room>/<tick>.json`). The official client uses it only when `options.official` is true; standalone servers provide the `/room-history` addition instead.

adaptations.platformSteamNews: A standalone server has no screeps.com news backend and relays the public Valve news feed instead; when that upstream is unavailable it reports HTTP 502 rather than inventing an empty feed.
adaptations.platformVersion: Community private servers (screeps/backend-local with screepsmod-admin-utils) publish the features their mods register and a configured shard name, which the official schema does not allow (override: PlatformVersion).

additions.platformRoomHistory: The official web client fetches room history from `/room-history?room=&time=` whenever `options.official` is false (private-server branch), so every standalone server must serve it.

notes.platformVersion: Standalone servers serve one world. `serverData.features` and `serverData.shards` may be absent (stock backend-local and OpenScreeps send neither), in which case the official client falls back to its market/auth feature set. With screepsmod-admin-utils, `/api/version` lists the features mods register (screepsmod-auth, screepsmod-admin-utils, screepsmod-mongo: their package version string, or no version) and `shards` holds the `shardName` setting, `[null]` until one is set. That name is only what `Game.shard.name` reports: socket channels, room history and requests carry no shard on a standalone server whatever it lists, because the official client qualifies them only when `options.official` is true and reads `shards` only to decide whether to show shard names (`_.some`, so `[null]` counts as none).
notes.platformSteamNews: Relays Valve ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp for the Screeps app (one item), cached for five minutes with concurrent requests coalesced.
notes.platformActivePromotion: No hosted item shop: the response is `{ok: 1}` without promotion fields.
notes.platformRoomHistory: `time` must identify a retained chunk base; at most `historyChunkSize` frames are returned and a missing chunk yields HTTP 404.

get.description: Room-history chunk endpoint of the private-server protocol. When `options.official` is false the official web client requests `http://<host>:<port>/room-history?room=<room>&time=<tick>` with `time` aligned to `serverData.historyChunkSize`, treats any non-200 status as missing and fills `room` when absent. The body is a history chunk (base tick plus tick-keyed object diffs) without the `ok` envelope.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Base game tick, normally aligned to the advertised historyChunkSize.

404.description: Requested history frame was not retained.

PlatformVersion.x-profile-reason: screepsmod-admin-utils replaces `/api/version` and publishes `config.backend.features` and its `shardName` setting: mod features carry their package version string or no version, and the shard list holds `null` until a name is set.

version.description: Feature version: a number for server features, the mod's package version string (for example `2.10.1`) for mod features, absent for some mod features (screepsmod-auth `auth-tokens`).

shards.description: Shard names. A standalone server lists at most the `shardName` setting of screepsmod-admin-utils, `null` until one is set, which is only what `Game.shard.name` reports: its socket channels, room history and requests carry no shard.
